summary: Tested N+1 query fix for entity-balances endpoint. All backend endpoints working correctly (10/11 tests passed, 1 skipped due to empty vendor list). Frontend Muhasebe tabs (Kuryeler, Restoranlar, Cariler) loading correctly with bulk balance fetching.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: calculate_entity_balances_map() function correctly aggregates balances in single MongoDB query (lines 131-161 in accounting_service.py)

Backend: GET /api/companies/{company_id}/entity-balances endpoint supports all types: courier, courier_archived, restaurant, restaurant_archived, vendor, vendor_archived (lines 673-755 in accounting.py)
Frontend: useAccountingTab.js fetchBulkBalances() correctly calls bulk endpoint instead of N+1 individual calls (lines 149-159)
Frontend: fetchEntities() and fetchArchivedEntities() use Promise.all to fetch list and balances in parallel (lines 180-208, 211-224)
Frontend: fetchEntityBalance() still used for single entity balance update after transaction (correct behavior for post-transaction refresh)
context_for_next_testing_agent: N+1 query fix verified. Test company has 0 couriers, 3 restaurants (Dönerci Ali, Kebapçı Mehmet, Pizzacı Ahmet), 0 vendors. All entity-balances endpoints return correct structure {balances: {entity_id: balance}}. Frontend correctly uses bulk endpoint for initial load and single-entity endpoint for post-transaction updates.
